title: Handling the maximum number of active user plane radio bearers in NB-S1 mode

entities.name: Maximum number of active user plane radio bearers in NB-S1 mode
entities.description: The condition where the maximum number of active user plane radio bearers in NB-S1 mode is reached, limiting the establishment of new DRBs.

entities.name: Upper layer request for more DRBs
entities.description: A request from upper layers for additional DRBs for PDN connections other than those already having DRBs.

entities.name: Upper layer request for exception data reporting
entities.description: A request from upper layers for user-plane resources specifically for exception data reporting.

entities.name: PDN connection release procedure
entities.description: The procedure to release a PDN connection, performed via explicit ESM signalling when needed to free up resources for new DRB requests.

entities.name: PDN connection for exception data reporting
entities.description: A PDN connection that is used for exception data reporting, which must not be released when the UE needs to free up resources.

entities.name: Explicit ESM signalling
entities.description: The signalling procedure used to release a PDN connection, ensuring proper protocol handling.

relations.description: The condition of maximum active bearers being reached guards the handling of upper layer requests for more DRBs.
The condition of maximum active bearers being reached guards the handling of upper layer requests for exception data reporting.
An upper layer request for more DRBs can establish the need to release a PDN connection.
An upper layer request for exception data reporting establishes the requirement to release a PDN connection.
The PDN connection release procedure includes the step of using explicit ESM signalling.
The property that a PDN connection is used for exception data reporting guards against its release in the PDN connection release procedure.
